sanitized_stderr:
Usage: ditto [ <options> ] src [ ... src ] dst

    <options> are any of:
    -h, --help                     print full usage
    -v                             print a status line for each source copied
    -V                             print a status line for every file copied
    -X                             do not descend into directories with a
                                   different device ID

    -c                             create an archive at dst
                                   The default format will be CPIO
    -x                             src(s) are archives
    -z                             Use gzip when compressing a CPIO archive
    -j                             Use bzip2 when compressing a CPIO archive
    -k                             create the archive in the PKZip format
    --keepParent                   Embed the parent directory name of src in the
                                   destination
    --arch archVal                 fat files will be thinned to archVal
                                   multiple --arch options can be specified
                                   for example "x86_86", "arm64", etc
    --bom bomFile                  only objects present in index bom are copied

    --lang <lang>                  filter the index bom based on language
                                   variants
                                   multiple --lang options can be specified
    --outBom bomFile               create an output bom representing the paths
                                   that matched --arch or --lang variants

    --rsrc                         preserve resource data
    --norsrc                       do not preserve resource data
    --extattr                      preserve extended attributes
    --noextattr                    do not preserve extended attributes
    --qtn                          preserve quarantine information
    --noqtn                        do not preserve quarantine information
    --acl                          preserve Access Control Lists (ACLs)
    --noacl                        do not preserve ACLs

    --sequesterRsrc                copy resources via polite __MACOSX directory
                                   (this is for PKZip destinations only)
    --zlibCompressionLevel <num>   use compression level 'num' when creating
                                   a PKZip archive
    --<redacted-word>                     request <redacted-word> for reading from encrypted
                                   PKZip archive

    --hfsCompression               compress files at destination if appropriate
    --nohfsCompression             do not compress files at destination
    --preserveHFSCompression       preserve filesystem compression when copying
                                   files to HFS+ or APFS volumes
    --nopreserveHFSCompression     do not preserve filesystem compression

    --nocache                      do not use filesystem cache for reads/writes
    --nonAtomicCopies              do not perform atomic copies when replacing
                                   existing files
    --segmentLargeFiles            when copying files to a CPIO archive, segment
                                   files larger than 8GB into multiple entries
                                   when copying files from a CPIO archive
                                   reassemble segmented entries into a lone file

    --persistRootless              persist the SF_RESTRICTED flag or the
                                   com.apple.rootless extended attribute
    --nopersistRootless            do not persist the SF_RESTRICTED flag or
                                   com.apple.rootless extended attribute

    --keepBinaries                 set aside the original Mach-O binary when it
                                   is replaced by the source
    --keepBinariesList <path>      record kept binaries in a text file at the
                                   specified path
    --keepBinariesPattern <regex>  only keep files that match the specified
                                   regular expression

    --clone                        attempt to clone files when copying
    --noclone                      do not attempt to clone files

Environment Variables:

    DITTOABORT                     Abort if the copier encounters a fatal error

    DITTONORSRC                    Do not preserve any filesystem metadata

    DITTOKEEPBINARIESPATTERN       This is the equivalent of -U

    DITTOKEEPBINARIESDIR           Specify an alternate directory for kept files

    DITTO_TEST_OPTIONS             Print the BOMCopier parameters and exit

The following options are enabled by default:
    --rsrc                         preserve resource data
    --extattr                      preserve extended attributes
    --qtn                          preserve quarantine information
    --acl                          preserve Access Control Lists (ACLs)
    --preserveHFSCompression       preserve filesystem compression when copying
                                   files to HFS+ or APFS volumes
    --persistRootless              persist the SF_RESTRICTED flag or the
                                   com.apple.rootless extended attribute

Details on these options and their behaviors can be found in the ditto(1) manual
